channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Picanha, prices and politics: What Brazil's favorite steak says about the election
item.description: Lula promised Brazilians four years ago they'd be able to afford picanha again. Now, as he seeks another term, the price of the country's favorite cut of beef is telling a different story.

item.title: En esta ciudad de Pensilvania, los dos partidos políticos buscan el voto latino
item.description: Los republicanos lograron avances con los latinos en el último ciclo electoral, pero la economía y la frustración por la política migratoria de Donald Trump han corroído ese apoyo.

item.title: COMIC: How the census gives your state power (and what Trump wants to change)
item.description: The census is used to determine how much say your state has in Congress and the Electoral College. President Trump failed to alter it during his first term, but he's trying again ahead of 2030.

item.title: Along U.S. Route 1, Maine voters worry about heating oil, gas and Canadian tariffs
item.description: Home to both Republican Sen. Susan Collins and Democratic candidate Troy Jackson, Maine's senate race has put rural Aroostook County in the spotlight.

item.title: Trump administration reverses stance on integration of people with disabilities
item.description: Disability rights advocates are angered by the latest reversal but are rallying behind proposed legislation and working with states to strengthen protections for community integration.

item.title: Father-in-law of trans NYT exec admitted killing him, worked 'in concert' with mother-in-law: docs
item.description: Shouyong Zhang allegedly admitted to shooting Jonathan McKinsey after surveillance video captured him and his wife opening fire in a Dublin park.

item.title: Pro-life group says mail-order abortion pills violate federal law, urges Trump admin to take action
item.description: The Restoration of America Foundation urges Attorney General Todd Blanche to enforce the Comstock Act against mail-order abortion pill shipments.

item.title: Biden-era federal prosecutor hit with criminal investigation referral over alleged false statements to FBI
item.description: A criminal referral sent to the Justice Department alleges ex-prosecutor Jina Choi misled FBI agents about her role in the IRL startup probe.

item.title: Trump’s special strategy to deport illegals gives him another tool for enforcement
item.description: The United States has deported some 25,000 illegal aliens to third countries under Trump, which includes targeting criminal aliens convicted of murder and rape.

item.title: Teen's tragic killing by illegal immigrant becomes flashpoint in battle for control of Congress
item.description: Sheridan Gorman's parents confronted Rep. Mike Lawler and Democrat Cait Conley over sanctuary city policies during a heated congressional debate.

item.title: Election crime arrests keep piling up as Dems insist it 'just doesn't happen'
item.description: New federal cases charge noncitizens with voter fraud across multiple states, clashing with Democrats who oppose the SAVE Act and deny it happens.

item.title: Watchdog finds Fed mishandled renovations that Trump tried to oust Powell over
item.description: The Fed’s watchdog found cost overruns but no evidence of criminal violations after the Justice Department dropped an investigation into the renovations earlier this year.

item.title: Democrats fail to stop Trump from canceling $810M in funds approved by Congress
item.description: Sen. Ron Johnson (R-Wisconsin) blocked the effort, meaning the Trump administration will succeed in eliminating the funding it deemed “wasteful.”

item.title: Hegseth bars military academies from hiring civilians as tenured professors
item.description: The move marks the latest effort by the Trump administration to exert more control over faculty at service academies.

item.title: Fearing AI, workers go back to school seeking jobs that still need a human touch
item.description: Some people are abandoning office jobs for teaching, health care and the trades. But switching to the new paths can come with trade-offs.

item.title: Immigrant shot by ICE in Austin is charged with assault
item.description: An affidavit unsealed Tuesday said the officer who shot Wilber Garcés Pérez was not wearing a body camera and another officer had turned his camera off.

item.title: Supreme Court allows third-country deportations to resume for now
item.description: The high court will later hear arguments and make a final ruling on the Trump administration’s controversial policy of sending migrants to countries where they are not citizens.

item.title: Jack Smith clashes with senators over Trump probes, says he will not be silenced
item.description: Jack Smith returned to Capitol Hill on Tuesday to defend his derailed efforts to prosecute President Donald Trump, telling lawmakers he would not “be silenced by continued threats of prosecution” from the president.

item.title: Trump’s playing his greatest hits. They don’t work as well as they used to.
item.description: With midterm elections a month away, the president is turning the audacity up to 11 as he labors to reverse his party’s decline in the polls.

item.title: Political climate has so soured for GOP, even Mississippi Democrats are hopeful
item.description: A Democrat hasn’t won a Senate race in the state since 1982, but a young district attorney has a message for party officials and donors: “If we try, we win these voters.”
